scope: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence promotion for Seagull Combination, Shining Slash, Shooting Strike, and Soaring Rush

records.name: Seagull Combination
records.mechanics: Flurry of punches followed by a powerful launching kick; additional Ki can increase the number of punches, and an unblockable spinning-kick option can be added.
limits: Official Dragon Ball material establishes the punch-rush, extra-Ki extension, and unblockable spinning-kick behavior; exact hit count/damage and reward probability remain unresolved.
Maintained repository reward sources disagree on presentation of the normal-clear slot; no Ultimate-Finish-only gate is inferred.

records.name: Shining Slash
records.mechanics: Sword-based Strike Super; charging raises the sword and, when released, teleports to the locked-on target for the slash. Current independent documentation records about 10% damage.
limits: Exact frame data and reward probability remain unresolved.
Current evidence supports Earthling/Saiyan CaC scope; no narrower form/gender gate is inferred.

records.name: Shooting Strike
records.mechanics: Ranged Ki Blast Super: Gamma 1 fires an energy bullet from his ray gun and follows a successful hit with a flying kick.
limits: Maintained reward data records a 50% Ultimate-Finish bonus slot; exact underlying drop mechanics remain unresolved.
Official material establishes the attack sequence but does not by itself establish CaC reward probability.

records.name: Soaring Rush
records.mechanics: Power Pole rush: the user strikes and kicks the opponent away, then chases them; holding the fly input improves the forward dash and permits an immediate follow-up.
limits: Maintained reward data records a 50% Ultimate-Finish gate; exact probability implementation remains unresolved.
No narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction is inferred.

evidence_boundary: Current official and independent Xenoverse 2 evidence was used to enrich mechanics and provenance. Existing reward conflicts remain bounded and no unsupported numeric drop probabilities were invented.
